title: Meridian Trust Bank Underwriting Criteria for Northgate Credit Cards
content:
Meridian Trust Bank underwrites every application for Northgate Credit Cards. The table sets out, for each card product, the bank's published criteria: the lowest credit score its published underwriting approves, whether the application requires the business's EIN, whether the applicant personally guarantees the account, the smallest credit line the bank assigns on approval, and whether an approved applicant can use the credit line the same day in a club.

## Criteria by card product

| Card product | Lowest credit score approved | Business EIN required | Personal guarantee by the applicant | Smallest credit line assigned on approval | Same-day use of the line in a club on approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | 640 | No | No | $500.00 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 660 | Yes | Yes | $1000.00 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 690 | No | No | $1500.00 | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 690 | Yes | Yes | $3000.00 | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 720 | No | No | $2500.00 | No |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 720 | Yes | Yes | $5000.00 | No |

## Reading the criteria

- **Credit score.** The figure is the lowest score the bank's published underwriting approves for that product. Hypothetical scores against the Northgate Rewards Visa Signature figure of 690: a score of 690 is not below the lowest approved score; a score of 689 is below it. A score at or above the figure is not in itself an approval.
- **Credit line.** An approved account's credit line is never below the product's figure. Hypothetical example: an approved Northgate Business Store Card account cannot be assigned a line of $900.00, because $900.00 is below $1000.00.
- **EIN and personal guarantee.** Both are required on exactly the three business products (Northgate Business Store Card, Northgate Rewards Visa Business, Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus) and on none of the consumer products.
- **Same-day use.** Only the Northgate Store Card and the Northgate Business Store Card let an approved applicant use the credit line in a club on the day of approval; on the four Rewards Visa products the answer is No.
